items.optimize_reason: Benchmark 2-day backfill on the mLYNEWjW pure engine. Balances holding horizon between 1-day (Sh 1.59, TO 114%) and 3-day (Sh 1.20, TO 68.8%), targeting Sharpe ~1.45 and Turnover ~80%.
2-day backfill with 2-day linear decay (weights 2/3 on Day 1, 1/3 on Day 2). Tapers holding to cut turnover from ~80% down into the 55%~65% compliant zone while retaining 67% fresh weight.
3-day backfill with 2-day decay window. Retains 3-day event breadth but concentrates 67% conviction in the primary 2-day reversal window, aiming for Turnover <= 55% and Fitness >= 0.80.
The champion return engine of Batch 10 (RRAObJVj, Ret 8.93%, 2Y 1.72) smoothed by 2-day linear decay. Direct attack to bring its 82.9% turnover down below 65% while keeping Sharpe high.
50 bps threshold filter: only initiates trades when intraday post-news move exceeds 0.5%. Eliminates small noise rebalancing, slashing turnover into the 30%~50% zone and boosting margin.
100 bps threshold filter: only trades high-conviction events where post-news drift exceeds 1.0%. Expected turnover 15%~30%, Margin > 6.0 bps.
Strict event gating: trades only when at least 1 high-price excursion event occurs today. Cleans out zero-count non-news days.
